caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur attached to a tooled leather strap. The spur is metallic in color, ranging from dull silver to a darker, aged patina, and features a small, round rowel with multiple pointed teeth. The leather strap is a warm brown color and is decorated with floral patterns and detailed carving, including a large flower on the side and scrolling leaf motifs. The border of the leather strap is scalloped, and a square-shaped leather piece is fastened where the spur meets the strap. The background is plain, cream or beige in color, with no other objects or features present. The composition centers the spur and strap horizontally across the page.
title: Spur
